subject: community-medicine
title: Cold Chain Equipment: ILR, Deep Freezer, Carriers and Temperature Monitoring

steps.title: Why potency lost never returns
steps.tx: **Cold chain failure** destroys potency invisibly: a heat-damaged vaccine looks normal, injects normally and protects nobody. Damage accumulates with every warm hour and cannot reverse on re-cooling. That single fact justifies temperature loggers, twice-daily recording and vial monitors at every link from national store to session site.
steps.say: Heat damage hides completely. The vial looks normal, injects normally, protects nobody, and re-cooling restores nothing. Cumulative invisible loss is why loggers, twice-daily records and vial monitors guard every link.

right.title: What actually happened
points: Potency lost hour by warm hour
Failure found only by audit or outbreak

steps.title: Walk-in freezers and coolers at the top
steps.tx: **Walk-in freezers** store oral polio vaccine frozen at state and regional stores, while walk-in coolers hold other vaccines at +2 to +8 degrees in bulk. Volumes shrink down the chain: national stores think in lakhs of doses, session carriers in dozens. Equipment choice at each level follows storage volume plus the temperatures its vaccines demand.
steps.say: Scale shrinks down the chain. Freezers at the top freeze polio vaccine in bulk; coolers hold the rest refrigerated. Each level's equipment matches its dose volume and temperature needs, down to dozens of doses in a session carrier.

steps.title: Ice-lined refrigerator: the facility workhorse
steps.tx: The **ice-lined refrigerator** holds +2 to +8 degrees through an ice lining that keeps contents cold during power cuts, its hold-over time deciding how long safety lasts without electricity. Vaccines sit in baskets by type, never against the freezing back plate, and the door stays shut. Twice-daily temperature recording, morning and evening including holidays, is non-negotiable discipline.
steps.say: One machine serves most facilities. Its ice lining rides out power cuts for a rated hold-over time. Baskets organise vaccines away from the freezing plate, and twice-daily temperature recording, holidays included, is non-negotiable discipline.

steps.title: Deep freezer discipline
steps.tx: **Deep freezers** make and store ice packs and hold only vaccines that tolerate freezing, chiefly oral polio vaccine where policy directs. Adsorbed vaccines (DPT, pentavalent, hepatitis B, tetanus toxoid) must never enter: freezing destroys their aluminium adjuvant structure irreversibly. Most freeze damage in real programmes happens here or against unconditioned ice packs in carriers.
steps.say: Freezers serve ice packs first. Only freeze-tolerant stock belongs inside. Adsorbed vaccines entering one lose their adjuvant structure forever. Most real freeze damage happens in freezers or against unconditioned packs touching vials in carriers.

rows: Frozen control vial for shake test

steps.title: Cold boxes, carriers and day carriers
steps.tx: **Cold boxes** move bulk vaccine between stores with packed ice for days, while vaccine carriers hold a session's supply for hours and day carriers serve a few vials for very short outreach. Conditioned ice packs, frozen then rested until water moves inside, protect adsorbed vaccines from contact freezing during transport. Vials travel in zipper bags, never loose in melt water.
steps.say: Transport has three sizes. Cold boxes move bulk for days, carriers serve one session, day carriers a handful of vials. Conditioned packs, rested until water sloshes, stop contact freezing. Vials ride in zipper bags, never loose in melt water.

left.title: Conditioned ice pack
points: Frozen then rested at room air

steps.title: Temperature monitoring beyond the thermometer
steps.tx: **Vaccine vial monitors** record cumulative heat on each vial, while refrigerator loggers and twice-daily charts record storage history; neither detects the other's enemy, since vial monitors ignore freezing. Freeze indicators and the shake test cover the cold side. Reading all three together, heat, freeze and storage record, is the complete monitoring habit examiners describe.
steps.say: Three monitors, three enemies. Vial labels remember cumulative heat, charts remember storage, shake tests expose freezing. Vial monitors never detect freezing, so reading all three together forms the complete habit.

steps.title: Reverse cold chain and surveillance samples
steps.tx: **Reverse cold chain** carries stool specimens from acute flaccid paralysis cases and other surveillance samples back to laboratories under the same temperature discipline, because a warm specimen kills virus before culture. The concept delights examiners: the chain runs both ways, vaccines down, specimens up, and surveillance quality depends on the return leg.
steps.say: The chain runs backward too. Stool specimens from paralysis cases travel up to laboratories cold, or virus dies before culture. Surveillance quality depends on that return leg as much as vaccine delivery depends on the forward one.

nodes.label: Specimen travels up cold to lab

steps.title: Cold chain sickness and breakdown protocol
steps.tx: On **equipment breakdown**, vaccines move immediately to the nearest working unit or into cold boxes with conditioned packs, the temperature excursion is recorded with duration, and vial monitor plus freeze status decide use, use-first or discard with the cold chain officer. Guessing silently and re-serving stock is the one unforgivable response; documented excursion with expert decision is the professional one.
steps.say: Breakdowns demand choreography. Move stock cold at once, record excursion and duration, then let monitor and freeze status decide use, priority use or discard with the officer. Silent guessing and re-serving is the only unforgivable response.

steps.title: Solar and passive innovations
steps.tx: **Solar direct-drive refrigerators** freeze an ice bank by day and cool from it through night and cloudy spells without batteries, suiting off-grid facilities where kerosene and electricity failed historically. Passive cold boxes extend outreach where no equipment exists. Technology changes down the decades; the discipline, hold +2 to +8 and prove it, never does.
steps.say: Sunlight now banks cold by day for the night, battery-free, where grids and kerosene failed. Passive boxes extend the last miles. Equipment evolves across decades; the discipline of holding range and proving it never changes.
